sourceRisks.meaning: Shapes may include outlined text or mathematical symbols; presence is not confirmation of text.
Bitmap presence does not establish embedded text; visual/source review required.

nativeDecisions.graphText: 56 native labels use true source character identities and placement coordinates. A upper y is positive; B/C/D upper y retains authored negatives. Each curve is bound to its actual owner path and matching visibility.
nativeDecisions.feedback: Eight source branches are queryable; only first four right branches are selectable by conditional host. Native titles, text, Close timing and two-attempt routing retained; decorative artwork remains separately recorded source.
nativeDecisions.audio: Nine MP3 streams decoded at22050Hz; optional Spanish at48000Hz. No original-runtime alignment or listening acceptance.
nativeDecisions.layout: Responsive A,C/B,D graph layout with source A motion/zoom progress, native unscaled text and local narrow-screen graph scroll.
